title: Accounts Payable Clerk - 6 Month FTC
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Hays is recruiting for an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant to join their finance team on an initial 6-month temporary contract, working for a company in Bedford. Part of a small team, this is a great opportunity to be part of a local established employer.
Your new role
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger experience who enjoys getting stuck in, resolving queries and helping a team work through a busy period. The immediate focus will be processing invoices, clearing outstanding items and supporting the smooth running of the AP function.Key duties will include:
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices
- Matching invoices against purchase orders
- Managing invoice approval workflows
- Supplier statement reconciliations
- Investigating aged and outstanding items
- Resolving invoice and supplier queries
- Liaising with internal teams regarding outstanding approvals
- Supporting the team in clearing an existing AP backlog

What you'll need to succeed
You'll have previous Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger experience, with a good understanding of invoice processing, purchase orders and reconciliations. You'll be confident working in a busy environment and able to pick up new processes quickly. Oracle experience would be beneficial but isn't essential. The business is also going through wider systems change, so exposure to SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar finance systems would be useful, although not essential.

What you'll get in return
- 6-month temporary assignment
- Salary equivalent of approximately £26,000
- Immediate start available
- Full training provided
- Great on-site facilities
- Exposure to financial systems and process change
- Monday to Friday 9-5pm
- Fully office-based

What you need to do now
If you're an experienced Accounts Payable professional who is immediately available or available at short notice, apply today for immediate consideration.
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Assistant Logistics Coordinator
description:
A leading aerospace manufacturer are looking for a proactive Assistant Logistics Coordinator to join a growing Supply Chain team and play a vital role in managing import, export, customs and freight operations.
- Role: Assistant Logistics Coordinator
- Duration: Initial 6-month contract
- Pay: 14 - 16 p/hr (Inside IR35)
- Location: Bedfordshire (Fully onsite)

As a key member of the Supply Chain team, you'll support the day-to-day management of imports, exports and customs activities.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinating customs clearances and international shipments.
- Reviewing and validating customs declarations and shipping documentation.
- Liaising with freight forwarders, customs brokers and suppliers to resolve shipment queries.
- Managing import and export records, ensuring complete audit trails and compliance documentation.
- Supporting Temporary Admission and Inward Processing customs authorisations.
- Assisting with CBAM reporting requirements and trade compliance activities.
- Providing support and guidance on HS Codes, Commodity Codes and CPC Codes.
- Preparing export invoices and shipping documentation using SAP.
- Working closely with internal departments to obtain customs, product and country-of-origin information.

You'll work with international suppliers, freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure goods move efficiently, compliantly and on time.

Key Requirements:
- Aerospace, manufacturing, engineering or similar environment experience
- Experience in logistics, exports, customs, shipping, international trade or freight forwarding.
- Strong understanding of import/export processes and customs procedures.
- Knowledge of commodity codes, customs documentation and UK customs legislation.
- Experience liaising with customs brokers, freight providers and external stakeholders.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- SAP experience

This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy and collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

If you're local to Bedfordshire, looking for a new role to develop your logistics and customs expertise within a dynamic business and happy to be fully onsite, apply now!

Temp to perm

Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.

What You'll Be Doing
- Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
- Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
- Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
- Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
- Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
- Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
- Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
- Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
- Participate in stock cycle counting.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
- Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
- Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.

Reporting to our Sales Support Manager, you will be responsible for generating new business opportunities whilst managing and developing an allocated portfolio of existing customers. This is a customer-facing role focused on building long-term relationships, identifying training requirements and driving revenue growth through both open and dedicated training solutions.

Working closely with the wider sales team, you'll proactively engage with new, existing and lapsed customers through phone, email and CRM activity. You'll play a key role in supporting customer retention, increasing account spend and ensuring a high level of service throughout the sales process.

Day to day you will:
Prospect and qualify new business opportunities through outbound sales activity
Manage inbound and outbound customer engagement across phone, email and CRM platforms
Identify customer training requirements, produce quotations and coordinate bookings
Build strong relationships with key decision makers to drive customer loyalty and repeat business
Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipeline activity and customer data
Support exhibitions, events and wider business development initiatives when required

PERSON SPECIFICATION: Sales Executive - Training, Education - B2 B Sales

We're looking for a motivated, resilient and customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building relationships. You'll be confident communicating with customers at all levels, comfortable working towards targets and proactive in identifying opportunities to grow accounts and generate new business. Most importantly, you'll have a positive, "can do" attitude and be willing to get stuck in as part of a collaborative team environment.

You will:
Have experience within a B2 B sales environment
Be confident managing both new business and existing customer relationships
Demonstrate resilience and adaptability within a fast-paced sales environment
Ideally have experience within construction, training, education or related sectors, although this is not essential

COMPANY:

We are a well-established, growing B2 B organisation operating across the training, compliance and specialist services space. Supporting thousands of businesses across the UK and internationally, we deliver a range of solutions that help organisations operate safely, effectively and in line with industry standards.

It is highly likely you will have worked in any of the following roles and/or markets, and worked with the following products and/or services: Sales Executive, Internal Sales Executive, Telesales Executive, Account Manager, Business Development Executive, Customer Success Executive - Training, Education, Construction, Compliance, Professional Services, B2 B Sales.
